buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing and Commissioning of Goods 3. Turnover

Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 4. Turnover OEM Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the OEM of the offered product during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the OEM is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. In case of bunch bids, the OEM of CATEGORY RELATED TO primary product having highest bid value should meet this criterion. 5. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Scope of Work: The bidder shall execute the construction work strictly as per the approved drawings, te chnical specifications, BOQ, and instructions issued by the competent authority. Any deviation shall requir e prior written approval. 2. Site Inspection: The bidder is advised to inspect the construction site and assess the site conditions, acc essibility, transportation requirements, availability of materials, and other relevant factors before submitti ng the bid. No additional claim shall be entertained on account of lack of site inspection. 3. Transportation and Labour: The bidder shall arrange transportation of all construction materials, machin ery, tools, equipment, skilled and unskilled labour required for execution of the work at their own cost. No extra payment shall be made for transportation, labour, loading, unloading, or other incidental expenses. 4. Quality of Materials: All materials used in construction shall be of good quality and conform to the releva nt BIS/IS standards and approved specifications. The materials shall be subject to inspection and verificatio n by the competent authority before use. Substandard or rejected materials shall be replaced by the bidde r at their own cost. 5. Execution as per Specification: The construction work shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved technical specifications, drawings, BOQ, applicable CPWD norms, and relevant IS codes, whereve r applicable. The bidder shall ensure proper workmanship and quality of construction throughout the execu tion period. 6. Storage and Safety: The bidder shall make necessary arrangements for safe storage of construction mat erials, tools, and equipment at the site. The bidder shall be responsible for maintaining proper safety meas ures, cleanliness, and protection of the site, workers, and institute property during execution of the work. 7. Inspection and Verification: The competent authority shall have the right to inspect and verify the materi als, workmanship, and progress of the work at any stage. The bidder shall provide necessary assistance du ring inspection. Any defective work or material detected shall be rectified or replaced by the bidder withou t additional cost. 8. Completion of Work: The bidder shall complete the entire construction work within the stipulated period mentioned in the bid/work order. Any delay attributable to the bidder shall be dealt with as per the applica ble GeM contract conditions and provisions of the work order. 9. No Additional Charges: The quoted rates shall be inclusive of all applicable costs, including materials, tra

nsportation, labour, loading/unloading, tools, machinery, fitting, installation, taxes, and other incidental ex penses required for satisfactory completion of the work. No additional payment shall be admissible beyond the accepted contract value, except as permitted under the contract. 10. Right to Reject or Cancel: Buyer reserves the right to reject any bid, cancel the bid process, or terminat e the contract at any stage in accordance with applicable GeM rules and contractual provisions, in case of non-compliance with bid conditions, submission of incorrect information, poor workmanship, use of substa ndard materials, or failure to execute the work satisfactorily. The decision shall be taken by the competent authority as per applicable rules. .
